opening.argument: The presentation explains a technology model in which gaming PCs become distributed infrastructure: it describes making “a bunch of mini data centers by turning gaming PC's into these mini data centers,” while gamers can access the arcade through a phone. The economic upside is presented in connection with hosting gameplay: a participant who sets up a node is described as an arcade owner, with people bringing their quarters to play games. That is an operational technology demonstration tied to supplying hardware, not a guaranteed-wealth pitch; no amount, timeframe, or assurance of easy returns is stated.

citations.quote: what we've been able to do is make a bunch of mini data centers by turning gaming PC's into these mini data centers
If you set up a node, you're essentially an arcade owner.
You're inviting people to come in with their quarters to play your games and you're getting the economic upside from it.
as a gamer, I can just use my phone and hop right into the arcade.
